meta.title: Malaria Parasitology & Vaccine Interventions Multi-Paper Synthesis (7 Papers)
meta.authors: Datoo MS, Ariey F, Wright KE, Luzzatto L, Thomson R, Wassmer SC, Bousema T, et al.
meta.journal: Multi-Journal Synthesis (Lancet, Nature, Blood, Nat Rev Microbiol)
meta.summary: Comprehensive multi-paper knowledge model synthesizing 7 seminal malaria studies: WHO-recommended pre-erythrocytic vaccines (R21/Matrix-M & RTS,S), artemisinin resistance genetics (PfK13), essential erythrocyte invasion machinery (Rh5/CyRPA/RIPR), host genetic resistance (HbS & G6PD), diagnostic evasion via pfhrp2 deletions, cerebral malaria microvascular sequestration, and transmission-blocking interventions.

articles.title: High efficacy and immunogenicity of R21/Matrix-M and RTS,S/AS01 malaria vaccines in African children
articles.authors: Datoo MS, Natama HM, Some AM, et al.
articles.summary: Clinical trial demonstrating 77% efficacy over 12 months for circumsporozoite protein (CSP) virus-like particle vaccine R21 formulated with Matrix-M saponin adjuvant.

articles.title: Kelch13 (PfK13) gene mutations underlying artemisinin resistance in Plasmodium falciparum
articles.authors: Ariey F, Witkowski B, Menard D, et al.
articles.summary: Discovers Kelch13 propeller domain mutations (C580Y, Y493H, R539T) as direct genetic markers conferring delayed in vivo parasite clearance following artemisinin monotherapy.

articles.title: Structural architecture of the Plasmodium falciparum Rh5-CyRPA-RIPR erythrocyte invasion complex
articles.authors: Wright KE, Hjerrild KA, Bartlett J, et al.
articles.summary: Elucidates the universal, non-redundant invasion machinery where PfRh5 binds host basigin (CD147) in complex with CyRPA and RIPR to mediate tight junction formation.

articles.title: Genetic diversity, G6PD deficiency, and sickle cell trait protection against severe malaria
articles.authors: Luzzatto L, Nguetse CN, et al.
articles.summary: Explains evolutionary balanced polymorphism wherein heterozygous hemoglobin S (HbAS) and G6PD variants impair intraerythrocytic parasite propagation.

articles.title: Emergence and continental spread of pfhrp2/pfhrp3 gene deletions evading rapid diagnostic tests
articles.authors: Thomson R, Parr JB, Cheng Q, et al.
articles.summary: Global surveillance detailing deletions in pfhrp2 and pfhrp3 genes producing false-negative results on standard HRP2-detecting rapid diagnostic tests (mRDTs).

articles.title: Pathogenesis of cerebral malaria: PfEMP1 cytoadherence, endothelial activation, and microvascular thrombosis
articles.authors: Wassmer SC, Taylor TE, Rathod PK, et al.
articles.summary: Mechanisms of severe cerebral syndrome driven by PfEMP1 binding to endothelial ICAM-1 and EPCR receptors, causing infected erythrocyte sequestration and edema.

articles.title: Epidemiology and biology of Plasmodium falciparum gametocytes and transmission-blocking interventions
articles.summary: Examines sexual stage biology, vector mosquito infection dynamics, and antibody-mediated transmission-blocking vaccines targeting gametocyte surface antigens like Pfs25.

nodes.name: PfK13 Propeller Protein
nodes.desc: Kelch13 propeller domain; mutations (C580Y) cause delayed parasite clearance.

nodes.name: PfRh5 Invasion Ligand
nodes.desc: Essential merozoite surface ligand binding host Basigin; leading blood-stage vaccine candidate.

nodes.name: CyRPA Protein
nodes.desc: Cysteine-rich protective antigen bridging PfRh5 to RIPR in the invasion complex.

nodes.name: RIPR Protein
nodes.desc: Rh5-interacting protein anchoring invasion complex to merozoite membrane.

nodes.name: PfEMP1 Adhesin
nodes.desc: Variant surface adhesin exported to erythrocyte knobs mediating microvascular cytoadherence.

nodes.name: PfHRP2 Antigen
nodes.desc: Histidine-rich protein 2 synthesized by trophozoites; primary target for rapid diagnostic tests.

nodes.name: Circumsporozoite Protein (CSP)
nodes.desc: Major surface antigen of pre-erythrocytic sporozoites incorporated in RTS,S and R21 vaccines.

nodes.name: Pfs25 Gamete Surface Antigen
nodes.desc: Zygote/ookinete surface antigen targeted by transmission-blocking antibodies in mosquito midgut.

nodes.name: Host Basigin (CD147)
nodes.desc: Erythrocyte surface receptor essential for PfRh5 binding and entry.

nodes.name: Endothelial ICAM-1
nodes.desc: Adhesion molecule on brain microvascular endothelium bound by dual-reactive PfEMP1.

nodes.name: Endothelial Protein C Receptor (EPCR)
nodes.desc: Vascular barrier receptor targeted by pathogenic CIDRalpha1 domains of PfEMP1.

nodes.name: Hemoglobin S (HbAS Trait)
nodes.desc: Heterozygous sickle mutation conferring up to 90% protection against severe cerebral malaria.

nodes.name: G6PD Enzyme Variant
nodes.desc: X-linked enzyme deficiency altering redox state and accelerating phagocytosis of rings.

nodes.name: Erythrocyte Merozoite Invasion
nodes.desc: Cascade involving attachment, tight junction formation, and parasitophorous vacuole entry.

nodes.name: Microvascular Cytoadherence
nodes.desc: Parasite sequestration in post-capillary venules evading splenic filtration clearance.

nodes.name: Delayed Parasite Clearance
nodes.desc: Cellular phenotype showing ring-stage survival and reduced artemisinin susceptibility.

nodes.name: Pre-Erythrocytic Hepatic Stage
nodes.desc: Asymptomatic hepatic schizogony phase occurring after mosquito bite inoculation.

nodes.name: Vector Transmission Cascade
nodes.desc: Cycle from human gametocytemia to mosquito gut fertilization and salivary gland sporozoites.

nodes.name: R21/Matrix-M Vaccine
nodes.desc: WHO-approved CSP particle vaccine yielding high sustained anti-sporozoite antibody titers.

nodes.name: RTS,S/AS01 (Mosquirix)
nodes.desc: First WHO-recommended pre-erythrocytic malaria vaccine targeting CSP repeat region.

nodes.name: Artemisinin Combination Therapy (ACT)
nodes.desc: First-line clinical regimen combining fast-acting artemisinin with long-acting partner drug.

nodes.name: Primaquine / Tafenoquine
nodes.desc: 8-aminoquinolines killing hypnozoites and clearing mature stage V P. falciparum gametocytes.

nodes.name: PfHRP2 Rapid Diagnostic Test (mRDT)
nodes.desc: Point-of-care lateral flow immunochromatographic cassette detecting circulating PfHRP2.

nodes.name: pLDH / Aldolase Combination RDT
nodes.desc: Alternative diagnostic test detecting parasite enzymes unaffected by pfhrp2 gene deletions.

nodes.name: Giemsa Blood Smear Microscopy
nodes.desc: Gold-standard laboratory quantification of parasitemia and morphological staging.

nodes.name: Anopheles Gambiae Mosquito
nodes.desc: Principal mosquito vector transmitting sporozoites during female blood meal ingestion.

nodes.name: Brain Microvascular Endothelium
nodes.desc: Target tissue in cerebral malaria undergoing tight junction breakdown and edema.

nodes.name: Diagnostic Escape / False Negatives
nodes.desc: Clinical risk where pfhrp2/3-deleted strains evade detection causing delayed treatment.
